title: Battery patents: Solid-state filings surpass lithium-ion to hit record high
content:
Global solid-state battery patent filings hit a record 2,230 in 2024, up 16%, with South Korea overtaking Japan, driven by Samsung SDI’s rapid growth. Meanwhile, lithium-ion patent filings fell nearly 15% to 2,092, while sodium-ion filings dropped 29%, signaling a shift in battery innovation toward solid-state technologies.
